drafts.body:
This post explores a hypothetical comparison between two local inference setups, A and B, focusing on time-to-first-token (TTFT). In this scenario, Setup A achieved an illustrative TTFT of 1.2 seconds, while Setup B took 2.4 seconds. It is crucial to note that this is a purely hypothetical example, not based on actual measurements or benchmarks. 

Both configurations, in this thought experiment, utilized the identical prompt and ran on the same unspecified hardware. Key performance indicators such as throughput, the quality of the generated answers, and any statistical uncertainty were not evaluated in this hypothetical context. 

Given these hypothetical figures, what factors might contribute to such a difference in initial response latency under otherwise identical conditions? This is intended purely for discussion, as no real-world data is presented here. F1, F2, F3, F4.
